## What this dashboard shows

- Tracks end-to-end close readiness across 5 ERP systems (1 real SAP BDC, 4 simulated) covering 11 entities and 31 months of Wipro Enterprises data through 2026-07-31
- Reports 4,214,121 lines landed with 0 unmapped lines, 584 of 588 intercompany pairs matched, and consolidated group net result of ₹569.48B
- Provides source-to-group P&L reconciliation showing entity amounts, elimination entries, and final group numbers

## What to report

- All 5 ERP sources are green: 4,214,121 lines fully mapped to group chart of accounts across 11 entities through 2026-07-31, with zero unmapped lines blocking close
- Intercompany matching 99.3% complete: 584 of 588 document pairs matched, with 4 exceptions totaling ₹35.6M unresolved (₹450K amount differences, ₹35.1M missing buyer entries)
- Consolidated group net result of ₹569.48B after eliminating ₹9.59B intercompany revenue and netting ₹22.2M in total eliminations
- Outstanding IC exceptions require resolution: 2 missing buyer records (₹33.7M and ₹1.4M from Infrastructure Engineering) and 2 amount mismatches (₹436K and ₹14K)

## Watch out for

- 4 of 5 ERP sources are simulated data (Dynamics 365, Oracle EBS, SAP S/4HANA system B, Tally Prime); only SAP S/4HANA (A) is real SAP BDC with 3.7M lines
- Intercompany elimination mismatch: ₹9.55B buyer cost vs ₹9.57B seller revenue creates -₹13.4M residual in consolidated intercompany purchases line – investigate ₹20M gap vs ₹9.54B matched amount
- Two material missing-buyer exceptions (ref 2025/0090556674 for ₹33.7M and 2025/0090515468 for ₹1.4M) both from Infrastructure Engineering to different buyers in recent months (Apr-Oct 2025) – why are buyer entries absent?
- Elimination impact on net result is -₹22.2M but intercompany purchases line shows -₹13.4M after eliminations – ask what other ₹8.8M eliminations are embedded and whether all IC profit is stripped
